title: Core weapons
text: Buildcraft The one you aim yourself. A core weapon is the one you point yourself. title: Quests and rewards
text: Progression One ask at a time, from somebody who wants something specific. One ask is active at a time, it comes from a person and never from a board, and the next step of a chain opens only when you turn in the one before it. 5 villagers want 24 very specific things.

title: Three Thorns
text: Three Thorns Find three thorns in one run. Three thorns from that flytrap thing. Don't ask. I need them for a frame and I am not explaining further. You did not ask. I appreciate that in a person. Sit down. These are yours now. The Tailor scavengerRun wearable quest reward

title: Five More Pods
text: Five More Pods Find five seed pods in one run. Now five seed pods. Same plant. It has forgiven you by now. Wool needs something to argue with while it dries. It had not forgiven you. Wear the cap anyway. The lump on the left is a design choice. The Tailor scavengerRun wearable quest reward

title: A Stiff Collar
text: A Stiff Collar Down one named boss. Bring me a piece of something with a name. I want a stiff collar. Nameless things go soft in the wash. Stiff enough. Hold still while I fit it round your neck. If it itches, that is the bramble doing its job. The Tailor trophyHunt wearable quest reward

title: The Shiny Bit
text: The Shiny Bit Down one named boss. Down the big one and bring me the shiny bit. I am building a coat. The coat has been a rumour here for two winters. That is the shiny bit. The coat is going to be loud. Take the scarf while I think about sleeves. The Tailor trophyHunt wearable quest reward

title: Bright Trim
text: Bright Trim Find four bright scraps in one run. Four bright scraps off the ground. The coat wants trim. It has opinions now, which is a bad sign in a coat. Trim acquired. The coat is now more of a weather event. You get the ribbon. The coat gets everything else. The Tailor scavengerRun wearable quest reward

title: Two Shoulders
text: Two Shoulders Down two named bosses. Two more named things. A coat has two shoulders. Do not come back with one of them and a promise. The coat is finished. I am giving you half of it. I am keeping the half with the pockets in it. The Tailor trophyHunt wearable quest reward

title: The Big Crab
text: The Big Crab Down one named boss. Everyone says you cannot touch the big one. I said you could. So now you have to, because I already told them you would. You touched it. I watched the whole thing from the fence. This is a medal. I made it out of a jar lid and some string. The Kid trophyHunt wearable quest reward

title: The Lantern Dare
text: The Lantern Dare Finish a run with the lantern uncracked. Take my lantern out there and bring it back not broken. It is the good one, so this counts for more than the last one. Not one crack in it. Nobody else even took it out of the yard. You get the crown. I am the one who decides about crowns. The Kid fragileDelivery wearable quest reward

title: The Hidden One
text: The Hidden One Find the one thing the map is hiding. There is one thing out there that nobody has ever got to. It is up high. That is the whole reason it is still up there. You got to it. I am going to be talking about this for a year. You do not get a thing for this one. You get called something. The Kid lostThing title quest reward

title: Four Sour Caps
text: Four Sour Caps Find four sour caps in one run. Four sour caps. The pale ones, off the ground, not off a stalk. They go in a loaf that I am not describing to you. Four. The loaf will be correct now. Take the apron. Everything I own is covered in flour anyway. The Baker scavengerRun wearable quest reward

title: The Deep Shelf
text: The Deep Shelf Find the one thing the map is hiding. Something out there is worth putting on the deep shelf. I will know it when you hand it to me. You will not. That is exactly it. Do not ask me what it is for. This cap is shaped like an egg. So is your head, roughly. The Baker lostThing wearable quest reward

title: The Egg Run
text: The Egg Run Finish a run with the egg uncracked. One egg. It goes out with you and it comes back whole. I have three of these left and two of them are opinions. Whole. I did not think that was going to happen today. There is nothing left to give you, so I am giving you a name. The Baker fragileDelivery title quest reward

title: The Colour In It
text: The Colour In It Find five coloured stones in one run. Five stones with the colour in them. You will know the colour. Everyone knows the colour. Nobody has ever been able to describe it. Four of these are quartz. The fifth one is also quartz. Here is a hundred and twenty. That is the claim being generous. The Prospector scavengerRun gold quest reward

title: The Deep Seam
text: The Deep Seam Find the one thing the map is hiding. There is a seam out there and it is higher up than a seam should be. Geology has been wrong before. Usually about me. That is the seam. That is not gold. I am choosing to stay hopeful. Take the pan. I have three and I only ever wash the one. The Prospector lostThing wearable quest reward

title: What Is Under It
text: What Is Under It Down two named bosses. Two big ones are sitting on my claim and neither one pays rent. I have asked politely. I have asked twice. Now it is your problem. Both of them. The claim is quiet in a way I do not entirely trust. Two hundred and sixty. Do not ask which pocket it came out of. The Prospector trophyHunt gold quest reward

title: The Assay
text: The Assay Find six assay samples in one run. Six samples. Good ones. I am finally going to have this thing tested. I have avoided doing this for eleven years and I am ready now. The report is back. There has never been gold here. Not once. I have no money left, so I am giving you the name instead. The Prospector scavengerRun title quest reward

title: The Overdue One
text: The Overdue One Find the one thing the map is hiding. One book left this building in 1806 and has not been seen since. It is up somewhere high. Books climb, given enough time alone. Returned. Two hundred and twenty years late, which I will waive. Take the spectacles. Their previous owner has stopped needing them. The Ghost Librarian lostThing wearable quest reward

title: The Marginalia
text: The Marginalia Find four margin notes in one run. Four loose margin notes. Somebody has been writing in my books. I would like the notes. I would also like a word with the somebody. This handwriting is mine. I have no memory of any of this. A hundred and forty, out of a fines drawer nobody audits. The Ghost Librarian scavengerRun gold quest reward

title: The Restricted Shelf
text: The Restricted Shelf Down one named boss. Something named is standing between me and the restricted shelf. It has been standing there for a while. It is not reading. The shelf is reachable. Everything on it is about the same subject. Two hundred. I would rather not explain why a library has this. The Ghost Librarian trophyHunt gold quest reward

title: The Archivist's Trade
text: The Archivist's Trade Finish a run with the lantern uncracked. Carry my reading lamp out and bring it back lit. The Archivist trades. He wants light. I want a book back. Neither of us wants to discuss it. Not a chip in it. He handed the book over without one word. Your account is clear. I am writing that down where people can see it. The Ghost Librarian fragileDelivery title quest reward

title: A Dog Out There
text: A Dog Out There Bring the stray home from one run. There is a dog out there and I have seen it twice and nobody believes me. Bring it back and then they will have to believe both of us. That is the dog. That is the exact dog. I was right in front of everyone. It came off its neck when it shook. You should have it, I think. The Kid pupRescue wearable quest reward

title: The Dog On My Claim
text: The Dog On My Claim Find three buried things in one run. Your dog has buried three of my things and will not say where. It has been digging all week and it has found more than I have. A spoon, a boot and my second-best pan. Better instincts than mine. A hundred and eighty. Consider it a finder's fee for the dog. The Prospector scavengerRun gold quest reward

title: The Dog's Record
text: The Dog's Record Find the one thing the map is hiding. Your dog is in one of my books. I would like the rest of that book. It is an old book, it is somewhere high, and it is about hauntings. Here it is. Same dog, same markings, four hundred years ago. Two hundred and twenty. I would advise you not to tell the child. The Ghost Librarian lostThing gold quest reward

title: The One It Picked
text: The One It Picked Bring the stray home from one run. The library lady told me what it is. I already knew. I named it first. Go and get it one more time. This time it is not going to leave. It is not going anywhere. It picked you, and it is very stubborn. It comes with you now. Into the actual fighting. I have checked. The Kid pupRescue unlock quest reward

title: Ship fragments
text: Progression 3 pieces of the ship that never made it to the wreck. These came down away from the wreck and stayed where they landed, out along the routes that lead off the hub. Nobody local has been in a hurry about them.

title: Stabiliser Vane
text: The sheared edge is still bright out here. It landed far enough out that nobody went looking. a torn attitude vane, one edge still bright where it sheared rim Navigation ship fragment

title: Coolant Manifold
text: The water has been working on it since the night you fell. It is still one piece. a bent manifold, furred with mineral where the water found it underway Life Support ship fragment

title: Hull Plate
text: It came down with you and stayed up here. Somebody nailed it flat and got on with their day. a curved hull plate, weathered to the colour of the barn it landed on rooftop Hull ship fragment

title: Wearables
text: Collection What the village hands you for doing it a favour. A wearable is what a quest pays you: somebody wanted something specific, you brought it back, and this is what they handed over. It bolts onto whichever hero you are playing, and it does nothing else.

title: Cosmetic styles
text: Collection Three colors each, and not one of them makes you stronger. A style is three colors: body, rim and accent. It changes nothing about how a run goes, which is the entire point of it.
